shinytoxstats: A Graphical Interface to the toxstats Toxicity Endpoint Methods

Source: R/shinytoxcalc-package.R
shinytoxstats-package.Rd

A Shiny application providing a point-and-click interface to the 'toxstats' package, which computes the standard endpoints of a concentration-response toxicity test by the decision rules the US EPA Whole Effluent Toxicity method manuals set out. Data are entered by pasting, by uploading a comma-separated file, or by uploading a spreadsheet laid out to the supplied template. Results are presented as the decision trail that justifies the selected test, alongside the endpoints and a concentration-response plot, and can be exported as a report, a spreadsheet, or the R code that reproduces the analysis.
